name: BANCO BRADESCO PFD 04 ADR
summary: BANCO BRADESCO PFD 04 ADR represents an American Depositary Receipt (ADR) for preferred shares of Banco Bradesco, a major Brazilian bank. These ADRs allow investors outside of Brazil to invest in the preferred equity of Bradesco. Banco Bradesco provides a wide range of financial services to individuals, businesses, and corporations in Brazil.
